about.title: About Me
about.intro: 3D web engineer with 5+ years building production experiences, from Volvo configurators to adidas. M.Sc. in Systems and Computing Engineering, focused on Visual Computing. Lately I also automate processes with AI. Keep reading, or better yet, let’s talk.
about.experience: My work spans global brands: 3D product configurators for Volvo and Jeep, checkout infrastructure at adidas supporting transactions in 30+ countries, and real time architectural visualizations for Amarilo and other real estate leaders through Umbra 3D Studio. I work across the stack, from React, Three.js and Angular on the frontend to Node.js, CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes on the systems side. Since 2025 I have added a new layer to that foundation: using AI to automate processes. I build daily with Claude Code, Codex, MCPs and similar tools, turning repetitive work into automated workflows. Open to freelance projects and full time roles
about.tagline: I write code in OOP; I think in Matrix 4x4; I celebrate in salsa.
